description: Downstream DriftingMol checks under alternative SELFIES VAE checkpoints.
notes: Each entry first builds a latent cache for the selected VAE if it is missing.
These runs test whether QED drifting depends on one SELFIES VAE architecture or beta setting.
They are extension-stage reviewer experiments and should be interpreted separately from the locked 8-page draft until complete.

entries.name: ext_vae_lowbeta_drift_qed_s42
entries.command: test -f outputs/publication_ext/vae_sensitivity/ext_V_BETA_LOW_vae_s42/final_metrics.json && if [ ! -f data/cache/zinc_latent_cache_ext_vae_lowbeta_s42.pt ]; then python scripts/build_selfies_latent_cache.py --vae_ckpt outputs/publication_ext/vae_sensitivity/ext_V_BETA_LOW_vae_s42/best.pt --graph_cache data/cache/zinc250k_smiles_cache.pt --output data/cache/zinc_latent_cache_ext_vae_lowbeta_s42.pt --batch_size 2048; fi && python -m src.train.train_selfies_cfg --config configs/publication_ext/vae_drift/ext_vae_lowbeta_drift_qed_s42.yaml
entries.purpose: downstream DriftingMol check using the completed low-beta SELFIES VAE
